title: Among female patients with uric acid levels above the normal threshold, ide
question: Among female patients with uric acid levels above the normal threshold, identify those who also have total cholesterol exceeding 250 and a negative KCT coagulation test. For these patients, return their ID, the date of their laboratory test with the highest LDH value within the normal range (<500), and their anti-Cardiolipin IgA concentration.

prediction.sql: SELECT p.XCL_058 AS ID, (SELECT l2.XCL_015 FROM Laboratory AS l2 WHERE l2.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058 AND l2.XCL_018 < 500 ORDER BY l2.XCL_018 DESC LIMIT 1) AS lab_date, (SELECT l3.XCL_043 FROM Laboratory AS l3 WHERE l3.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058 ORDER BY l3.XCL_015 DESC LIMIT 1) AS anti_cardiolipin_iga FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F' AND p.XCL_058 IN (SELECT l.XCL_014 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.XCL_022 > 6.5 AND l.XCL_026 > 250) AND p.XCL_058 IN (SELECT e.XCL_001 FROM Examination AS e WHERE e.XCL_009 = '-')

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  p.XCL_058 AS ID,
  (SELECT l2.XCL_015
     FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
      AND l2.XCL_018 < 500
    ORDER BY l2.XCL_018 DESC
    LIMIT 1) AS lab_date,
  (SELECT l3.XCL_043
     FROM Laboratory l3
    WHERE l3.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
    ORDER BY l3.XCL_015 DESC
    LIMIT 1) AS anti_cardiolipin_iga
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
      AND l.XCL_022 > 6.5
      AND l.XCL_026 > 250
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.XCL_001 = p.XCL_058
      AND e.XCL_009 = '-'
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
       (SELECT T3."XCL_015"
          FROM Laboratory AS T3
         WHERE T3."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"
           AND T3."XCL_018" < 500
         ORDER BY T3."XCL_018" DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS lab_date,
       T2."XCL_006" AS anti_cardiolipin_iga

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T2."XCL_001" = T1."XCL_058"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_002" > 6.0
  AND T2."XCL_004" > 250
  AND T2."XCL_003" = '-'
